title: Edaravone mitigates hemorrhagic cystitis by modulating Nrf2, TLR-4/NF-kappaB, and JAK1/STAT3 signaling in cyclophosphamide-intoxicated rats.
authors: Hassanein, Emad H M; Ahmed, Marwa A; Sayed, Ahmed M; Rashwan, Eman K; Abd El-Ghafar, Omnia A M; Mahmoud, Ayman M
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究依达拉奉对大鼠环磷酰胺诱导出血性膀胱炎的保护作用，涉及Nrf2、TLR-4/NF-kappaB和JAK1/STAT3信号通路，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hemorrhagic cystitis is a potentially deadly complication associated with radiation therapy and chemotherapy. This study explored the protective effect of edaravone (ED) on cyclophosphamide (CP)-induced hemorrhagic cystitis, oxidative stress, and inflammation in rats. The animals received 20 mg/kg ED for 10 days and a single injection of 200 mg/kg CP on day 7. CP induced tissue injury manifested by the diffuse necrotic changes, disorganization of lining mucosa, focal hemorrhagic patches, mucosal/submucosal inflammatory cells infiltrates, and edema. CP increased malondialdehyde (MDA), nitric oxide (NO), tumor necrosis factor-alpha, and interleukin 6 (IL-6), decreased IL-10, and upregulated toll-like receptor 4 (TLR-4), nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) p65, Janus kinase 1 (JAK1), and signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) in the urinary bladder of rats. ED effectively prevented the histopathological alterations, decreased MDA, NO, and inflammatory mediators, and downregulated TLR-4, NF-kappaB, JAK1, and STAT3 in CP-induced rats. Treatment with ED upregulated ikbeta kinase beta, IL-10, nuclear factor-erythroid 2 related factor 2 (Nrf2), and cytoglobin, and boosted glutathione, superoxide dismutase, and glutathione S-transferase. Molecular docking simulations revealed the ability of ED to bind TLR-4, NF-kappaB, JAK1, and STAT3. In vitro, ED increased the cytotoxic activity of CP against HeLa, Caco-2, and K562 cell lines. In conclusion, ED prevented CP-induced hemorrhagic cystitis in rats by attenuating oxidative stress, suppressing TLR-4/NF-kappaB, and JAK1/STAT3 signaling and boosted Nrf2, cytoglobin, and antioxidants.
abstract_zh: 出血性膀胱炎是放射治疗和化疗相关的一种潜在致命并发症。本研究探讨了依达拉奉（edaravone, ED）对环磷酰胺（cyclophosphamide, CP）诱导的大鼠出血性膀胱炎、氧化应激和炎症的保护作用。动物接受20 mg/kg ED治疗10天，并在第7天单次注射200 mg/kg CP。CP诱导的组织损伤表现为弥漫性坏死变化、黏膜衬里结构紊乱、局灶性出血斑、黏膜/黏膜下炎症细胞浸润及水肿。CP增加了大鼠膀胱中的丙二醛（malondialdehyde, MDA）、一氧化氮（nitric oxide, NO）、肿瘤坏死因子-α和白细胞介素6（interleukin 6, IL-6），降低了IL-10，并上调了toll样受体4（toll-like receptor 4, TLR-4）、核因子-κB（nuclear factor-kappa B, NF-kappaB）p65、Janus激酶1（Janus kinase 1, JAK1）和信号转导与转录激活因子3（signal transducer and activator of transcription 3, STAT3）。ED有效预防了组织病理学改变，降低了CP诱导大鼠中的MDA、NO和炎症介质，并下调了TLR-4、NF-kappaB、JAK1和STAT3。ED治疗上调了ikbeta激酶β、IL-10、核因子-红细胞2相关因子2（nuclear factor-erythroid 2 related factor 2, Nrf2）和细胞珠蛋白，并增强了谷胱甘肽、超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶。分子对接模拟揭示了ED与TLR-4、NF-kappaB、JAK1和STAT3结合的能力。在体外，ED增强了CP对HeLa、Caco-2和K562细胞系的细胞毒性活性。总之，ED通过减轻氧化应激、抑制TLR-4/NF-kappaB和JAK1/STAT3信号通路，并增强Nrf2、细胞珠蛋白和抗氧化剂，预防了CP诱导的大鼠出血性膀胱炎。
